correction_1_llama_margin.retracted_wording: selected by tie-break; -6 and -4 are tied
correction_1_llama_margin.why_wrong: The scores are not equal. -6 is strictly greater than -4, so the tie-break branch of the frozen selection rule was never reached.
correction_1_llama_margin.frozen_wording: The predicted score of -6 is slightly higher than that of -4, but the difference is only about 0.00006, so the two are effectively indistinguishable; -6 was NOT chosen by tie-break.
correction_1_llama_margin.consequence: Any verdict that -6 was correctly selected must be reported together with this margin. The Llama selection does not distinguish -6 from -4 and must not be presented as if it did. Qwen's margin over its runner-up is 0.13701904204322435, three orders of magnitude larger, and the two must not be described with the same confidence.

clarification_2_direction.means: The sign of the argmax over ALL FIVE alpha cells, expressed relative to alpha=0. It is a property of the five-point ordering.
clarification_2_direction.does_not_mean: A prediction made from the alpha=0 cell alone, and not a per-question prediction of any single cell.

frozen_state.locked: predictor, features, selected workpoint and success criteria may not change after this amendment

addition_4_fixed_workpoint_transfer.rationale: The five-point ordering test asks whether the predictor can RANK doses. The fixed-workpoint test asks the question a practitioner actually faces: take the alpha that was already established on GSM8K and apply it unchanged to a new task. It is a single paired contrast, so it needs no Holm correction across doses, and it cannot be influenced by the GSM-Hard predicted scores.

llama.source: frozen GSM8K discrete optimum (asymmetric peaked working-point response; sharp optimum -6, collapse at -8)

qwen.source: frozen GSM8K saturation onset (first_acc 86.00 at +8; +10/+12 not significantly different and outside the P3 dose set)

addition_4_fixed_workpoint_transfer.selection_provenance: Both alphas are read from the frozen GSM8K record and were NOT chosen using any GSM-Hard predicted score. They coincide with the five-point predicted best for both models, which is a fact about the data and not a selection step.
addition_4_fixed_workpoint_transfer.test: paired per-question difference in accuracy between the fixed alpha and alpha=0, on the same 300 questions, using the frozen offline extractor
addition_4_fixed_workpoint_transfer.statistic: exact two-sided McNemar on the discordant pairs, reported with the discordant counts and the paired difference in percentage points
addition_4_fixed_workpoint_transfer.family: ONE test per model. Reported separately from, and never pooled with, the five-point omnibus family.
addition_4_fixed_workpoint_transfer.success: the fixed alpha improves over alpha=0
addition_4_fixed_workpoint_transfer.failure_is_informative: A null here with a correct five-point ordering would mean the predictor ranks doses but the GSM8K workpoint does not transfer; the two readouts are reported independently and neither overrides the other.
